case.summary: Investigation into card C12785-K2 following an autonomous monitor alert for unusual device sharing. Two online transactions totaling $300.12 were conducted on 2016-12-31 using a Safari 10.0 device profile. This device profile is shared with 8 other cards and belongs to a community with a fraud rate 1.6x the bank average. The card has a history of confirmed fraud, and the current activity matches behavioral fingerprints of prior card-not-present fraud cases like CC-3986 and CC-5065.

sar.narrative: This report details suspicious online activity involving card C12785-K2 and cardholder C12785. On December 31, 2016, two transactions (IDs 3588461 and 3588462) totaling $300.12 were conducted in rapid succession. These transactions were initiated from region 327 through a shared device profile, '? | ? | safari 10.0 | ?', which has been linked to eight other cards. Network analysis places this device within a community of 1,148 cardholders that has a confirmed fraud rate 1.6 times the bank average. The behavioral fingerprint of this activity matches eight prior confirmed fraud cases, including CC-3986 and CC-5065, which involved similar card-not-present patterns. Furthermore, card C12785-K2 has a history of account takeover as documented in case CC-5233. The use of a shared device profile for coordinated online purchases suggests a high probability of fraud. Consequently, the bank has blocked the card and initiated monitoring for all connected accounts. This report is filed due to the connection to a shared device profile and high-risk community.

stop_reason: The card was blocked and a report filed per policy sections 3a, R6, and R2 because the activity connects to a shared device profile and matches confirmed fraud fingerprints.
